snippet.title: Columns - Uzebox Gameplay
snippet.description:
Columns is a fast paced competitive puzzle game for 1 or 2 players. Fight to the end, crush or be crushed!

Developed by Lee Weber (D3thAdd3r)
You can download the game here: https://uzebox.org/wiki/Columns

#retrogaming #retrogames #uzebox #uzeboxgames #theforeseenarcade #columns 

In case you ask, yes. RetroArch does allow for RetroAchievements support. And this clone of Columns is one of the Uzebox games that have an achievement set.
